'''Putty''' was a type of soft, pliable material with applications in demolitions. It was [[Color/Legends|brown]] in color, and cool to the touch. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] demolitions expert [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] used putty loaded with [[Nergon-14/Legends|Nergon-14]] explosive to get into a safe during a [[Heist on the Song of the Clouds|heist]] on the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]''.<ref name="Herdd" />
